GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your free Groq key (gsk_...). Only used by the browser when ALLOW_SERVER_KEYS is 1; otherwise paste it in the app.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Optional. Free Tavily key (tvly-...) for Scout's web search. Same ALLOW_SERVER_KEYS rule as above.

ALLOW_SERVER_KEYS.description: Optional. Set to 1 so the app uses the two keys above without pasting them in the browser. Only do this while the Codespace port stays Private.
